violations.text: The outside bar does not have a hand-washing sink that is conveniently located and/or readily accessible. Hand-washing sinks must be located to allow convenient use by employees in food preparation, food dispensing, and ware-washing areas. Per PIC, handwashing sink will be installed. New Violation. Correct By: 09/29/2026

ROP lobster was observed thawing with ROP packaging still intact. Lobster was observed between 37-38 DF and was taken completely out of packaging at the time of inspection. Proper thawing methods reviewed. New Violation. Correct By: 09/08/2026

The door to the outside, located in the dining room and garage door, is not tight-fitting. Outer openings of a food establishment must be protected against the entry of insects and rodents by tight-fitting doors. New Violation. Correct By: 09/22/2026
Various food/boxes of food were observed stored on the floor in the walk-in cooler and walk-in freezer. Food must be stored at least 6 inches above the floor. New Violation. Correct By: 09/08/2026

The facility is lacking thermo labels or similar internal temperature indicating device for the dish machine in the kitchen. Establishment is to obtain thermo labels or similar internal temperature indicating device. New Violation. Correct By: 09/11/2026

The non-food contact surfaces of both ice machines have an accumulation of dust, dirt, food residue, and other debris. Non-food contact surfaces must be cleaned to sight and touch. New Violation. Correct By: 09/08/2026

The ceiling over the Buffalo Chopper area is not covered with tiles/surfaces that are smooth, durable, and easily cleanable. Area is to be covered with proper surface characteristics. New Violation. Correct By: 12/08/2026

The garage door weather seal was observed to be not tight-fitting to the ground. Outer openings of a food establishment must be protected against the entry of insects and rodents by tight-fitting doors. Weather strip to be replaced to prevent possible entry of rodents/pests. New Violation. Correct By: 10/15/2025

The ceiling over the Buffalo Chopper area is not covered with tiles/surfaces that are smooth, durable, and easily cleanable. Area is to be covered with proper surface characteristics. New Violation. Correct By: 09/15/2025

At the time of inspection, the Food Safety Certificate as well as the Certified Food Safety Manager License through RIDOH CFP were both observed to be recently expired. PIC is to renew/retake the food safety course as well as renew the RIDOH CFP Certified Food Safety Manager License when completed. At the time of inspection, the PIC provided proof of food safety course application. PIC to send confirmation of successful course completion to this inspector. New Violation. Correct By: 09/11/2023

Proper cooling methods were not used for time/temperature control for safety (TCS) foods. Large quantities of Recently Prepped Lobster Salad, weighing approximately 10 lbs., were placed in the refrigerator in 10" deep covered containers and observed at 55 degrees Fahrenheit. Lobster salad is to be placed in shallow containers no greater than four inches deep prior to be placed in deep covered containers. New Violation. Correct By: 09/11/2023
